items.stem: A report is due at 5 pm. At 3 pm you spot a data inconsistency that could affect one section, and checking it will take about two hours.

options.label: A
options.text: Submit on time and say nothing, since it may be minor.

options.label: B
options.text: Inform your manager and propose a short delay or flagging the section.

options.label: C
options.text: Quietly stay late and submit after the deadline without telling anyone.

options.label: D
options.text: Submit on time with the affected section removed and no explanation.

items.stem: A senior colleague asks you to skip a mandatory approval step to speed up a task.

options.label: A
options.text: Skip it, since they outrank you.

options.label: B
options.text: Politely decline and explain the reasoning

options.label: C
options.text: Complete the task, then backdate the approval.

options.label: D
options.text: Report the colleague to compliance without speaking to them first.

items.stem: A teammate repeatedly misses handoffs, which delays your work.

options.label: A
options.text: Quietly take over their tasks.

options.label: B
options.text: Discuss the issue privately and agree on a better handoff routine.

options.label: C
options.text: Raise it in the next team meeting so everyone sees the pattern.

options.label: D
options.text: Escalate to your manager without speaking to the teammate.

items.stem: Your manager is away. Another department asks you to complete an urgent task today, but the task requires approval or access that is normally handled by your manager.

options.label: A
options.text: Complete the task yourself and bypass the usual approval process.

options.label: B
options.text: Decline the request, explaining that your manager is currently unavailable to review or authorize the matter.

options.label: C
options.text: Contact your manager. If unavailable, proceed with tasks within your authority,  and document any pending approvals.

options.label: D
options.text: Ask the other department to wait until your manager returns before taking any action.

items.stem: A peer criticizes your proposal in a meeting.

options.label: A
options.text: Restate your points more firmly.

options.label: B
options.text: Ask what concerns them and offer to test the idea with data.

options.label: C
options.text: Immediately withdraw the proposal at that time due to the peer's feedback.

options.label: D
options.text: Lobby other attendees privately before the next meeting.

items.stem: You have three tasks due today: an urgent request from a director, a deliverable another team is waiting on, and a routine report.

options.label: A
options.text: Do them in the order received.

options.label: B
options.text: Tackle the easiest tasks first to secure quick wins and build momentum, then address the remaining items

options.label: C
options.text: Confirm the director's actual deadline, tell the waiting team your revised timing, and defer the routine report.

options.label: D
options.text: Do only the director's request and tell no one about the others.

items.stem: You realize you made an error in a report you submitted last week, and the error may have affected some of the information presented.

options.label: A
options.text: Remain silent and offer no further comments, as the final report has already been successfully submitted.

options.label: B
options.text: Correct the report yourself without informing anyone.

options.label: C
options.text: Inform your manager, correct the error, and communicate the error to anyone who received the original version.

options.label: D
options.text: Wait to see if someone notices the error before taking action.

items.tag: Adapting to change (Rule adherence / Decision making)
items.stem: Your company replaces a process you prefer, with a new one.

options.label: A
options.text: Keep using the old method quietly while hoping the discrepancy goes unnoticed.

options.label: B
options.text: Learn about the new process, then raise specific concerns with evidence.

options.label: C
options.text: Complain to colleagues but follow the new process.

options.label: D
options.text: Wait until someone forces you to switch.
